STYLE

OVERALL SIZE

Makes the rundown, clocks, logo and ticker bigger on screen. The flash banner and cards keep their size.

BREAKING BANNER

Inside the strip, the banner takes the ticker's place while it is up, then the ticker comes back. If a countdown is on screen it takes the countdown's row and keeps a small clock on the right.

WHERE THE RUNDOWN SITS

Along the top suits up to about eight short topics. Topic size (RUNDOWN tab) sets how big the bar is.

To resize the sidebar, the logo block or the strip, drag their edges in the preview.

Loading the default fills the editor only. Nothing changes on air until you publish.
